title: Scrambled Tofu Breakfast Tacos
blurb: Soft corn tortillas filled with seasoned scrambled tofu and salsa for a simple savoury breakfast.
steps: Drain the tofu and press it between kitchen paper for 10 minutes to remove excess water, then crumble it into small pieces with your hands.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and add the crumbled tofu.
Sprinkle in the onion powder, garlic powder, turmeric and salt, then stir well to coat the tofu evenly.
Cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tofu is heated through and starting to turn golden at the edges.
Stir in the salsa and cook for another 2 minutes until warmed through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave according to packet instructions.
Slice the spring onions thinly and scatter them over the scrambled tofu, then spoon the mixture into the warm tortillas to serve.
